localChanges: In British English, the final Civilisation Score now uses the number format as well, so 1234 reads 1,234 (#682).
The year, your empire's details and the game menu now sit in a bar across the top of the screen, and the map runs underneath it, the full width (#697).

The world map and the active unit float over the map's top left, and can be collapsed from their headings; they stay that way the next time you play. The active unit's panel goes when no unit is active, and a unit that would be hidden under them is brought into view, as at the edge of the screen. On a narrow window they sit above the map instead (#697).
Each trade route on the city screen now shows one Trade icon for each point it adds, and the Intelligence Report shows the Gold icon beside a treasury instead of a $ (#683).

The top bar now shows the advance being researched with the Research icon, a progress bar and the turns left, and opens the Science report when clicked; your treasury with the Gold icon and its change each turn, in red when it is falling, which opens the Trade report; your government, which starts a revolution when clicked; and your tax, luxury and science split beside the Trade icon, which opens Adjust trade rates (#698, #683).
